description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Regulations of Suwa Sahanaya Catholic Church in Weligama D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Home Affairs under the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Chapter 175), establishing legal frameworks and regulatory requirements for pilgrimages at a specific Catholic church. It outlines powers of government officials, establishes prohibited activities, and sets compliance requirements - all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
